interface.longDescription:
Turn ChatGPT conversations into accurate, compliant, on-brand business documents with Templafy, the agentic document generation platform for enterprises.
Templafy for ChatGPT connects conversational AI with enterprise document generation, document automation, and content governance. Research, analyze, summarize, and draft in ChatGPT, then use Templafy Document Agents to transform that work into editable, business-ready presentations and documents using your organization's approved templates, brand assets, enterprise knowledge, business data, and compliance rules.
Instead of copying AI-generated content into PowerPoint or Word, searching for the latest template, or fixing layouts by hand, teams can move from conversation to professional output with less manual document work. Templafy combines Agentic workflows with rules-based automation and centralized control, helping organizations scale business content creation while maintaining brand compliance, accuracy, and consistency.

Create content such as:
- Sales presentations, pitch decks, and client presentations
- Proposals and RFP responses for proposal management workflows
- Quarterly business reviews, account plans, and customer summaries
- Executive presentations, internal reports, and research briefs
- Consulting and professional services deliverables
- Knowledge-sharing decks and other business-critical documents

Why enterprises use Templafy:
- Agentic document generation: Turn prompts, research, and source material into strong business documents.
- Document automation: Use approved templates, reusable content, business rules, and enterprise data to reduce repetitive work and manual copy-paste.
- Enterprise content governance: Centrally manage templates, content, assets, AI instructions, and permissions across teams.
- Brand compliance: Apply approved branding, existing PowerPoint layouts, Word templates, content, and document standards throughout the creation workflow.
- Workflow integration: Create content for the Microsoft Office formats businesses rely on, while continuing to work with ChatGPT and your existing technology ecosystem.

For employees, Templafy reduces time spent finding templates, locating approved assets, reformatting content, and correcting layouts, leaving more time for customers, analysis, strategy, and other high-value work.
For Marketing and Brand teams, Templafy supports self-service content creation with centralized template management, approved content, brand assets, and governance controls.
For IT and AI teams, Templafy provides an enterprise document orchestration layer for Agentic workflows. Administrators can govern how templates, organizational content, business data, document standards, and AI capabilities are used without creating a disconnected document process. Instead of regenerating all content with AI, Templafy reuses much of the existing content, which reduces overall AI usage costs.
Templafy works with the tools employees already use and connects ChatGPT to trusted enterprise context through MCP (Model Context Protocol) and enterprise integrations. The result is a faster path from an AI conversation to professional, governed business content in familiar document formats.
AI is changing where knowledge work happens. Employees increasingly research, analyze, and draft in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, but the final output still needs to meet enterprise standards.
It needs to be accurate and high quality.
It needs to reflect the organization's brand.
It needs to use approved content, including existing material that should be reused rather than regenerated.
It needs to comply with business rules and governance requirements.
And it needs to work in the document formats businesses rely on.
Templafy bridges that gap. Think, research, and draft with ChatGPT. Use Templafy to create consistent, compliant, on-brand presentations and documents with less manual work.
